t_advice_summary_textbox.text: The gnoes that take you to the forest are coloured green, yellow, orange and blue. All other colours take you to a different forest. Pick one forest consistently until the number of mushrooms go down for example to 3 mushrooms or less, then pick the other forest as the number of mushrooms available in this one should start to increase.

vb_textbox.text: Green, yellow, orange and blue gnomes take you to one forest which has a YELLOW basket. The other colours will take you to a different forest which shows a RED basket. Choose one forest consistently until you start to see the number of mushrooms decrease (to 1, 2 or maximum of 3), then switch to the other forest as the number of mushrooms in this one will start to increase. The moment you get 0 mushrooms switch back to the other forest and providing the number of mushrooms you get increases, stick with that particular forest until the rule of 3 or less occurs, then change forest. This will maximise your chance of getting a good score. Try to be quick as you don't have long to make a decision on the colour gnome you select, so its important to keep the colours of one forest in your head as you play the game.
